scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.firebase:serve: npm run build && npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only hosting,firestore
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
